summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology filed a Form 6-K disclosing an October 5, 2026 Cogni AI Healthcare Licence and Strategic Collaboration Agreement with BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. (Nasdaq: BGLC). Ruanyun grants an exclusive ten-year Malaysian healthcare license to its Cogni AI document-intelligence platform, renewable for two five-year terms, with 10% royalties on collected qualifying receipts and no minimum. Consideration is 410,000 BGLC shares, contractually stated at $3.5 million, plus a reciprocal share swap of 150,000 BGLC and 500,000 Ruanyun shares. Closing is pending conditions, including PRC approvals; termination outside date March 31, 2027. This is an ordinary commercial license, not a special situation.
